messages:
Maya: FYI CloudWave asked for a lightweight ref-arch + Terraform modules to publish in their marketplace. They want a one-click quick-deploy, cross-arch support (x86 / Graviton / Ampere), minimal networking (VPC + subnet), optional private-mode, and outputs for endpoint + metrics. Also want a CI smoke runner that hits healthcheck and runs a tiny inference. Partner expects a preview in ~2 weeks. Thoughts?

Aditya: Sounds doable. Key question: do they want model artifacts baked into the module or to pull from the Redwood hosted catalog? Hosted catalog == much simpler. Private-mode means image packaging + registry creds and more security docs.

Jordan: Suggest we split into three reusable modules: network, runtime, and app. Keep the runtime module opinionated about inference service but minimal. Example usage: 
```hcl
module "redwood_runtime" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refarch-modular//modules/runtime"
  version = "v1.0.0"
  instance_type = var.instance_type
}
```
That keeps marketplace template just wiring modules together.

Erin: Perf + ops notes: add an `accelerator_compat` var to pin arch (arm64/x86) and a k8s nodeSelector/nodeAffinity example. Also include a sane autoscaler policy default for marketplace templates so customers don't get surprise bills.

Maya: Agreed. For the CI smoke runner I was thinking GitHub Actions that deploys into the partner sandbox and runs two checks: `/health` and a tiny inference (100 tokens) against a small model. Quick example: 
```yaml
name: marketplace-smoke
on: workflow_dispatch
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v1
      - run: terraform init && terraform apply -auto-approve
      - run: |
          ENDPOINT=$(terraform output -raw endpoint)
          curl -fsS "$ENDPOINT/health" || exit 1
          curl -sS -X POST "$ENDPOINT/generate" -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' || exit 1
```
This can be gated for marketplace CI so partner can kick it off in their account.

cloud-partner-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing requirements -> pricing metadata, region support matrix, supported architectures, README quickstart, security notes, and small acceptance test results. See internal checklist: https://internal.redwood/marketplace-publish-checklist

Aditya: I'll take ownership of the runtime module and cross-arch packaging docs (including example AMIs/container tags for arm/x86). Erin, can you own autoscaler + k8s affinity defaults? Maya will handle partner comms and marketplace metadata. Jordan, can you add acceptance tests + smoke script?

Erin: Yup, I'll add an HPA snippet and node affinity examples, plus a CI matrix example for arm/x86. Will include a cost/throughput note in the README.

Jordan: I'll add `tests/smoke.sh` to repo that runs the two checks and a minimal generation eval, plus GH Actions workflow.

Maya: Plan: rough PRs by EOD Thu (10 days from now), partner preview Wed next week. Sync call Friday 10:00am PT to unblock. @Aditya @Erin @Jordan :thumbsup:

Aditya: :thumbsup:
